seo.title: Contact
seo.description: Talk to Altrazen about a web application, a SaaS product, a mobile app, or a codebase that needs taking over. We reply within one business day.

hero.heading: Tell us what you're building
hero.description: Or what is already broken. Give us a couple of paragraphs and we will tell you honestly whether we are the right studio — and if we are not, who you should be talking to instead.

form.heading: Send a message
form.successMessage: Message sent. We reply to every enquiry within one business day.
form.errorMessage: That did not send. Nothing you typed has been lost — try again, or email us directly.

alternatives.heading: What happens next
alternatives.description: We read every message ourselves and reply within one business day. If there is enough to talk about we will suggest a call; if we are not the right fit we will say so in the reply rather than booking a call to tell you.
